sources.title: Rastier et al2025, Reappraisal of Pseudobornia ursina
sources.notes: Author postprint fulltext downloaded and relevant primary text personally read. Original Fig3 vegetative fossils and Fig15 fertile reconstruction pixels inspected. One/two second-order axes per trunk node; leaves on third/fourth order axes, up to four per node, feather-like dissected leaves. Fig15 fertile structures deliberately not incorporated in sterile form. Publisher page unavailable; author repository is primary author postprint.
